chunks.subject: AP Physics C: E&M
chunks.title: Q4 Qualitative Quantitative Translation (QQT) — 8 points
chunks.content: AP Physics C: E&M FRQ 4 is Qualitative Quantitative Translation (QQT), 8 points, scored by lettered sub-points. The QQT task connects qualitative reasoning with quantitative analysis around a claim. Q4 topic: magnetism and current (magnetic force/field, induction, or Ampère's law). Points reward: a correct claim/prediction, qualitative reasoning citing the relevant E&M principle, a consistent quantitative derivation, and agreement between the qualitative and quantitative arguments. Common failure: a claim without a supporting principle; quantitative work inconsistent with the qualitative reasoning; sign/direction errors in the magnetic interaction.

chunks.content: Q4 (QQT) scored 8/8 — a correct claim, sound qualitative E&M reasoning, a consistent quantitative derivation, and agreement between the qualitative and quantitative arguments. Full-credit model.

chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4B, 4/8
chunks.content: Q4 (QQT) scored 4/8 — earned the claim and some qualitative reasoning but lost points where the quantitative argument was incomplete or inconsistent with the qualitative claim. Illustrates a half-connected qualitative–quantitative response.

chunks.subject: AP Physics C: E&M
chunks.title: Q4 exemplar — Sample 4C, 1/8
chunks.content: Q4 (QQT) scored 1/8 — earned only a single sub-point (e.g., a bare claim), losing the principle-based reasoning and the quantitative support. Illustrates a response that cannot link qualitative and quantitative E&M reasoning.
